harnessNotes: Provider configuration uses the actual components.statistic API. The first fixture used a nonexistent top-level statistic prop; it was corrected and all 12 reproductions were rerun against exact baseline source copies, all failing.
Baseline copies and temporary reproduction test were removed after capture; production files were never reverted during concurrent verification.

Browser axe requires a running clock; pausing all browser timers while awaiting axe stalls the harness. Axe now runs before the clock pause and after resume; real clock assertions still use controlled browser time.
The fixture now serves an explicit empty data favicon instead of masking the initial missing-favicon 404.

Default fontSizeHeading3 is 24 in the actual theme, while old docs/preparation fallback claimed 30. The corrected browser default assertion follows the actual Alias; source token override assertions remain exact.

Only root type-export ordering changed after runtime freeze. All eleven component/runtime source hashes are unchanged; emitted root JavaScript equals the inventory root index. Final strict types and published declarations are checked again.
Nested-provider VTU selectors use get(root).get(child) with real Teleport, preserving the real node assertions.
